mn-county-commissioner-roster.summary: No card names your county commissioner. The districts are not on the map yet either, and when they arrive they will name nobody.
mn-county-commissioner-roster.why: The Secretary of State publishes every county's commissioner districts as map data, and no publisher — the state included — pairs those districts with the people who hold them.
mn-county-commissioner-roster.wanted: A statewide list pairing each of the 447 commissioner districts with the person holding it, or a certified-returns feed that names commissioner contests by district.

mn-county-officers.summary: Your County card names the county and nobody who runs it — no board, no auditor, no sheriff, no attorney.
mn-county-officers.why: Minnesota has no statewide list of county officers. Each county publishes its own, and this app has read none of them yet.
mn-county-officers.wanted: A statewide list of Minnesota's elected county officers, or a per-county page set this app can read on a weekly schedule.

mn-legislature-roster.summary: Your Minnesota Senate and House cards name the district you are in and nobody who holds it.
mn-legislature-roster.why: The Legislature publishes both rosters and this app has not built them yet. The cards link each chamber's own member directory instead of naming a member it has not verified.
mn-legislature-roster.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

mn-tribal-government.summary: No card names the tribal nation whose land you clicked on, or its government. Eleven nations hold reservations in Minnesota and a twelfth holds land in trust here, and not one of them appears on any card.
mn-tribal-government.why: Each nation publishes its own council, and its own election districts where it elects by district, on its own site. No state or federal source lists them together, so this app has no roster it could name anyone from.
mn-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council members, and its district map where it elects by district.
